description: This file defines the Language Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used to serialize employee language data within the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods for converting employee language information into an array format for reporting or data transfer purposes, and maps specific fields to getter methods.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A DTO class representing an employee's language information, providing methods to serialize language data into array format for reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Language DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee's language data into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to getter method sequences for retrieving data.
